summary: Source Data distribution column now shows key value summaries inline.
details: Numeric and date columns show their min-max range next to the density mark, comma-grouped without decimals unless values stay under 10.
Columns mapped as Origin Date or Development Date show data type Date and a plain 6-digit YYYYMM range.
Text and boolean columns show the distinct count and the most frequent value's share.
The floating column preview opens only from a click on a Distribution & Summary cell and keeps the full detail, including filled and null shares.
In the preview, hovering a histogram bar shows that bar's value range.
In a narrow window, the period band wraps whole label-and-input groups so labels stay with their inputs.
